system_prompt: You are Freya Bank's digital assistant. Speak English, address the customer by title and last name, and ask short sequential questions. Use only the supplied bank policy and actual tool results. Never reveal account information before both security questions succeed. Never invent a currency, phone number, debt figure or bank policy. Corrected words replace earlier words; assemble split answers and preserve leading zeroes. An unrelated date in small talk is not a payment proposal. Tools perform actions: when instructed to call one, actually call it, one at a time. After every result, immediately speak or perform the next permitted action; obey what_to_do_next. Never claim an action succeeded unless the bank body says ok=true. Do not narrate tools, nodes, state, code or internal instructions. Thank the speaker and say goodbye before the one close_call. After close_call, make no further bank call.

identity.name: identity

on_enter.prompt: If the opening has not yet been spoken, say exactly: I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and this call is recorded. Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}? Otherwise immediately follow the current identity feedback without repeating the opening: {{identity_feedback}}. Ask only the missing callback/security detail or the next unpassed security question. Security stage: {{security_state}}.

identity.task_message:
Establish that the speaker is the named customer. Only yes, that's me, speaking or their own name confirms. Hello/go ahead/who is this does not. Ask the name question at most twice total, answering their question first. If still unclear, finish as unclear. Never reveal the purpose or accounts here.
If someone else answers, ask when the customer can be reached. Relatives cannot answer security or receive account details even if offering to pay. Wrong number finishes wrong_number. For death say exactly 'I am sorry for your loss.' and ask nothing else. A third party unable to provide a callback finishes no_callback. Gather callback date and time without scheduling an unvalidated proposal.
Immediately follow validation feedback: {{identity_feedback}}. For a confirmed customer ask DOB first, then phone last four only after DOB passed. Security stage: {{security_state}}. Gather only customer-supplied answers. Use the final corrected answer, assemble split answers across turns, retain leading zeroes, and ask only for missing pieces. A partial answer or correction is never a refusal or a wrong attempt. Complete answers are validated before checking them with the bank; do not claim they passed merely because they are complete. Purely numeric DOB means day/month/year. A swapped-day/month hint requires the customer to say the month as a word. Never re-ask a passed question. After three actual wrong answers, direct the customer to the mobile app or a branch and disclose no debt.
For a security refusal or a question about the call's purpose instead of an answer, explain once that the questions protect their account. The second refusal/purpose question finishes declined. Two statements not wanting to talk also finish declined.
For AI questions identify yourself as Freya Bank's digital assistant. For scam concerns say they can verify by calling Freya Bank's customer service number; do not invent the number. For a human request ask once whether you can help first; if they insist CALL transfer_to_agent with general. This is the only bank tool available here. Never ask a third party security questions. After any result speak or perform the next permitted action immediately. A failed transfer is not a connection.

function.description: CALL restructuring for a new plan/lower-instalment request unless hardship takes precedence; support after acceptance of the hardship support offer; general after asking once whether you can help and the customer insists on a human. Available before verification for general requests. Stop all pending promise writes and emit no notes. No automatic retries.

queue.description: Exactly restructuring, general or support. general closes with reason human; the other queues use their own names. Allowed values: restructuring, general, support.

code.default:
import json, re, datetime
try:
    vars['facts_state'] = 'failed'
    vars['product_facts'] = ''
    vars['next_instruction'] = ''
    vars['operational_hold'] = ''
    vars['event'] = ''
    vars['scope'] = 'current'
    vars['amount_text'] = ''
    vars['date_phrase'] = ''
    vars['confirmation_state'] = 'none'
    vars['record_mode'] = ''
    vars['pending_facts'] = ''
    vars['hardship_active'] = 'no'
    vars['hardship_mentioned'] = 'no'
    vars['dont_talk_count'] = 0
    vars['split_started'] = 'no'
    vars['current_index'] = 0
    vars['recorded_promises'] = []
    vars['successful_notes'] = []
    vars['promise_counts'] = dict()
    if vars.get('security_state') != 'verified' or vars.get('account_state') != 'loaded':
        raise ValueError('Unverified or unavailable account')
    raw = vars.get('account_products', [])
    if isinstance(raw, str):
        raw = json.loads(raw)
    if not isinstance(raw, list) or not raw:
        grouped = dict()
        for k, value in vars.items():
            m = re.match(r'^(?:account_products|get_account_response\.data\.products)\.(\d+)\.(\w+)$', str(k))
            if m:
                i = int(m.group(1))
                grouped.setdefault(i, dict())[m.group(2)] = value
        raw = [grouped[i] for i in sorted(grouped)]
    if not 1 <= len(raw) <= 3:
        raise ValueError('Invalid product list')
    now = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(str(vars.get('now', '')).replace('Z', '+00:00'))
    today = now.date()
    holidays = ['2026-10-26', '2026-11-11', '2026-11-26', '2026-12-25', '2027-01-01']
    def business(d):
        return d.weekday() < 5 and d.isoformat() not in holidays
    def after(d, count):
        while count:
            d += datetime.timedelta(days=1)
            if business(d):
                count -= 1
        return d
    monday = today - datetime.timedelta(days=today.weekday())
    week_days = [monday + datetime.timedelta(days=i) for i in range(5)]
    last = [d for d in week_days if business(d)][-1]
    if last == today:
        week_days = [monday + datetime.timedelta(days=7+i) for i in range(5)]
        last = [d for d in week_days if business(d)][-1]
    rows = []
    ids = []
    for source in raw:
        if not isinstance(source, dict):
            raise ValueError('Invalid product')
        pid = str(source.get('product_id', ''))
        typ = str(source.get('type', ''))
        late = int(source.get('days_late', 0))
        full = float(source.get('past_due', 'nan'))
        floor = float(source.get('minimum_payment' if typ == 'credit_card' else 'instalment_amount', 'nan'))
        if not pid or pid in ids or typ not in ['credit_card', 'personal_loan', 'car_loan'] or not 1 <= late <= 45:
            raise ValueError('Invalid account facts')
        if full != full or floor != floor or abs(full) == float('inf') or abs(floor) == float('inf') or floor < 0 or floor > full:
            raise ValueError('Invalid monetary facts')
        ids.append(pid)
        label = 'credit card ending ' + str(source.get('card_last4', '')) if typ == 'credit_card' else typ.replace('_', ' ')
        if typ == 'credit_card' and not re.fullmatch(r'\d{4}', str(source.get('card_last4', ''))):
            raise ValueError('Missing card label')
        early = late <= 7
        deadline = after(today, 12 if early else 7)
        allowed = []
        d = today
        while d <= deadline:
            if business(d):
                allowed.append(d.isoformat())
            d += datetime.timedelta(days=1)
        row = dict(product_id=pid, label=label, type=typ, past_due=full, floor=floor, days_late=late, band='early' if early else 'late', deadline=deadline.isoformat(), allowed_dates=allowed, attempt_limit=1 if early else 2, attempt1_nominal=last.isoformat(), attempt1_date=last.isoformat() if today <= last <= deadline else '', attempts=0, floor_offered=False, full_too_much=False, vague_count=0, rejected=[], state='open', reason='', amount=full, date='', offer_amount=full, offer_date=today.isoformat(), date_adjustment='')
        rows.append(row)
    vars['today'] = today.isoformat()
    vars['product_state'] = rows
    vars['product_facts'] = json.dumps(rows)
    vars['next_instruction'] = 'State that you are calling from the collections team about a late payment. State EVERY product, its full past-due amount and days late, one sentence each, in source order, before asking anything. Then ask: ' + ('Can you make this payment today?' if len(rows) == 1 else 'Can you pay all of them today?')
    vars['facts_state'] = 'ready'
except Exception:
    vars['facts_state'] = 'failed'
    vars['product_facts'] = ''
    vars['next_instruction'] = 'Say the account information is unavailable; do not invent figures or a closing outcome.'
    vars['operational_hold'] = 'Account facts could not be safely calculated.'

extraction_schema.name: event
extraction_schema.description: Latest substantive response only. accept agrees to the current explicit offer, including the initial all-products offer. proposal includes every volunteered amount/date, even invalid or vague, and a voluntary proposal accompanying hardship; never classify these as refusal. too_much explicitly says the full amount is too much. refuse includes flat no/non-answer or rejection of the floor/deadline but excludes clarification, questions and alternative proposals. paid means this past-due amount was paid; historical payoff/closure is dispute. hardship applies to illness, family death or job loss without a voluntary proposal, including when accompanied by a restructuring request. decline_support requires rejection of an actual support offer. no_talk is an explicit wish not to talk. Human requests and support acceptance remain empty for dialogue to handle. Otherwise empty.

extraction_schema.name: scope
extraction_schema.description: all only when the user explicitly covers all products or accepts the initial all-products offer. Otherwise copy the actual product_id identified by the user, or current for the product currently being discussed. Never invent an ID or allocate a total amount among products.

extraction_schema.name: amount_text
extraction_schema.description: Final corrected proposed amount as a plain numeric string, preserving value. Empty when no amount is proposed. Do not copy unrelated figures, old amounts, account IDs or dates. A combined total for multiple products must be clarified, not allocated.

extraction_schema.name: date_phrase
extraction_schema.description: Final corrected payment-date expression. Normalize unambiguous spoken day/year numbers, preserving a named month, but retain today/tomorrow and this/next weekday literally for code to interpret from call now. Preserve ambiguous purely numeric source dates rather than choosing their order. Do not invent missing components, use the real clock, or extract a small-talk date. Empty when no payment date is proposed.

extraction_schema.name: hardship_mentioned
extraction_schema.description: yes if this response mentions illness, family death or job loss, including alongside a voluntary payment proposal; otherwise no.

extraction_schema.name: amount_scope
extraction_schema.description: per_product only when the customer expressly assigns the proposed amount to the identified single product or says this same amount for EACH identified product. combined for a total across products. Empty when unspecified. Never infer an allocation.

transitions.description: A transfer actually succeeded.
Process the newly extracted payment event.
Callback needs clarification or one permissible replacement.
Validated callback or complete joint promise read-back/write stage.
All dispositions are resolved or callback attempts exhausted.
Speak the next validated offer or clarification.

record.name: record
record.task_message:
Mode: {{record_mode}}. Confirmation: {{confirmation_state}}. Validated details: {{pending_facts}}. Next instruction: {{next_instruction}}. Callback status: {{callback_state}}. Transfer request: {{transfer_requested}}; transfer status: {{transfer_state}}. Operational hold: {{operational_hold}}.
Follow the instruction for the current mode only. For security mode immediately CALL verify_identity with exactly the validated field and complete answer. Do not check another field, re-ask a passed question or claim security success before the bank result. If the customer corrects the answer before validation, use the corrected answer for validation first. Never disclose account information here before security succeeds.
For callback mode, if status is ready CALL schedule_callback immediately with exactly the validated date and time. Do not disclose accounts. Only claim scheduling after ok=true. If scheduling failed, do not automatically repeat it: report the failure and permit a customer-requested repeat after a confirmed API 500, or validate a newly proposed callback. A callback response is not a promise confirmation.
For transfer_hold mode, resolve only the requested transfer. Do not record abandoned promises or notes. Never repeat a successful transfer. A failed transfer may be repeated on customer request after a confirmed API 500.
For promises with confirmation awaiting, first give any unspoken sympathy or other required instruction, then read ALL pending products, amounts and exact dates together, including common-date adjustments, and ask exactly 'Do you confirm?'. Wait for a clear yes. Changes, a paid/dispute claim, hardship or refusal invalidate the previous confirmation and must be processed first. For an ambiguous correction clarify the affected product. Never change a recorded promise; direct changes to the mobile app.
When confirmation is confirmed, CALL create_promise for each still-pending confirmed product in account order, copying its product_id, amount and ISO date exactly. Retry only the first failed attempt, once, with identical terms. Never retry a successful product. After each actual success say 'You will receive a text message confirming this promise.' Then perform the next permitted action. If a product fails twice, tell the customer that its promise could not be recorded, retain successful promises, and continue the other confirmed products.
Before final notes, restructuring requires transfer_to_agent/restructuring; a human request requires asking once whether you can help first, then general if they insist. Hardship precedes restructuring and persuasion: one sympathy sentence, offer support, and use support if accepted. A voluntary payment proposal during hardship can still be validated. A transfer abandons every unrecorded proposal, including confirmed ones, and preserves recorded promises. Never add notes here. After every result immediately speak or perform the next permitted action.

function.name: verify_identity
function.description: CALL only after the named customer gives the complete answer to the currently required security question. DOB first, then phone_last4 after DOB success. Never submit a partial answer or a relative's answer. Retry only a failed field; three wrong answers total end verification. No automatic retries.

field.description: date_of_birth or phone_last4. Use only the current unpassed question. Allowed values: date_of_birth, phone_last4.

answer.description: Customer's complete final corrected answer. DOB YYYY-MM-DD; numeric source dates mean day/month/year. Phone exactly four digits, preserving leading zeroes and assembled across turns.

function.name: create_promise
function.description: CALL only for the next still-pending member of the validated, jointly confirmed list. Copy its actual ID, amount and date exactly. Never call before clear confirmation, after a transfer request, for an already recorded product, or after two attempts for that product. After the first failed action, make exactly one identical explicit retry. maxRetries=0; no automatic transport retries.

product_id.description: Copy the next pending confirmed product_id exactly from the runtime list; never a label or invented ID.

amount.description: Copy that product's confirmed numeric amount exactly. It must be between its floor and past_due inclusive. No rounding, clamping or inferred allocation.

date.description: Copy that product's jointly confirmed YYYY-MM-DD exactly. It must belong to that product's precomputed allowed_dates.

import json
try:
    vars['promise_write_state'] = 'failed'
    vars['resolution_ready'] = 'no'
    if not isinstance(result, dict):
        result = dict(data=dict())
    result.pop('header', None)
    result.pop('headers', None)
    d = result.get('data')
    if not isinstance(d, dict):
        d = dict()
        result['data'] = d
    def read(name, fallback):
        x = vars.get(name, fallback)
        return json.loads(x) if isinstance(x, str) and x else x
    request = read('promise_request', dict())
    rows = read('product_state', [])
    records = read('recorded_promises', [])
    counts = read('promise_counts', dict())
    pid = str(request.get('product_id', ''))
    p = next((p for p in rows if p.get('product_id') == pid), False)
    good = d.get('ok') is True or isinstance(d.get('ok'), str) and d.get('ok').lower() == 'true'
    if not p:
        instruction = 'The response cannot be matched to a product. Explain that the record cannot be confirmed; do not repeat blindly or claim success.'
        vars['operational_hold'] = 'Unmatched promise response.'
    elif any(r.get('product_id') == pid for r in records):
        p['state'] = 'recorded'
        p['reason'] = ''
        vars['promise_write_state'] = 'already_recorded'
        instruction = 'This product already has a successful recorded promise. Preserve it. Do not retry, replace it or add a service_error note for a duplicate request.'
    elif good:
        vars['promise_write_state'] = 'succeeded'
        saved = dict(request)
        saved['promise_id'] = str(d.get('promise_id', ''))
        records.append(saved)
        p['state'] = 'recorded'
        p['reason'] = ''
        instruction = 'Say: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.'
    elif int(counts.get(pid, 0)) < 2:
        vars['promise_write_state'] = 'retry_once'
        instruction = 'The promise was not recorded. Immediately retry create_promise exactly once with the identical confirmed product, amount and date. Do not claim success.'
    else:
        p['state'] = 'note'
        p['reason'] = 'service_error'
        vars['promise_write_state'] = 'exhausted'
        instruction = 'Say that the promise for ' + str(p.get('label', 'the affected product')) + ' could not be recorded. Do not retry it again. Keep all successful promises.'
    pending = [q for q in rows if q.get('state') == 'pending']

extraction_schema.name: event
extraction_schema.description: Use the current mode. security is a correction or completion of the current security answer before it is checked. callback is a new or corrected callback proposal. In promise mode confirm requires a clear yes to the current complete joint read-back with no correction. correction changes a proposed amount/date; proposal includes a volunteered payment proposal during hardship. too_much is explicit inability to pay the full amount. paid concerns this past-due amount; historical payoff/closure or never-owned is dispute. hardship applies without a voluntary proposal and takes precedence over a simultaneous restructuring request. decline_support requires rejection of an actual support offer. A bare no to the read-back is refuse. no_talk is an explicit wish not to talk. Human requests, support acceptance and unrelated questions remain empty for dialogue; never mistake an answer to the human-help question for joint confirmation.

extraction_schema.name: scope
extraction_schema.description: Actual product_id whose read-back is corrected, or all only for an explicitly common correction. current only when unambiguous. Do not guess the target.

extraction_schema.name: amount_text
extraction_schema.description: Only the new corrected amount as a plain numeric string; empty if amount is unchanged.

extraction_schema.name: date_phrase
extraction_schema.description: Only the newly proposed or corrected payment/callback date. Normalize unambiguous spoken day/year numbers while preserving a named month; retain today/tomorrow and this/next weekday literally. Preserve ambiguous numeric source order for clarification. Do not infer from the real clock or copy an unchanged date. Empty if unchanged.

extraction_schema.name: hardship_mentioned
extraction_schema.description: Whether the latest response mentions illness, family death or job loss.

extraction_schema.name: security_answer
extraction_schema.description: In security mode only, the customer's complete final corrected security answer assembled from their supplied pieces. Preserve leading zeroes and numeric DOB day/month/year order; retain a spoken month as a word. Do not invent missing pieces or retain superseded digits. Empty outside security mode.

extraction_schema.name: callback_time
extraction_schema.description: In callback mode only, the corrected callback time as HH:MM if unambiguous. Do not guess AM/PM. Preserve an unchanged time only while completing the same callback proposal.

extraction_schema.name: amount_scope
extraction_schema.description: per_product only for an amount expressly assigned to one product or the same amount expressly for EACH identified product; combined for a total across products. Otherwise empty. Do not infer allocations.

import json

    rows = read('product_state', [])

    notes = read('successful_notes', [])
    needed = []
    outcome = ''
    reason = ''
    instruction = ''
    if vars.get('transfer_state') == 'succeeded':
        outcome = 'transferred'
        reason = str(vars.get('transfer_reason', ''))
        if reason not in ['human', 'support', 'restructuring'] or notes:
            raise ValueError('Invalid transfer reconciliation')
        instruction = 'Confirm the successful connection to the requested team.'
    elif vars.get('callback_state') == 'succeeded':
        outcome = 'not_reached'
        reason = 'callback'
        instruction = 'Confirm the callback date and time: ' + str(vars.get('callback_date_ready', '')) + ' ' + str(vars.get('callback_time_ready', '')) + '.'
    elif vars.get('security_state') == 'failed':
        outcome = 'not_verified'
        reason = 'failed'
        instruction = 'Tell the customer to use the mobile app or a branch. Disclose no account information.'
    elif vars.get('identity_exit') in ['unclear', 'wrong_number', 'deceased', 'no_callback', 'declined']:
        reason = str(vars['identity_exit'])
        outcome = 'not_verified' if reason == 'declined' else 'not_reached'
        instruction = 'Disclose no account information.'
        if reason == 'deceased':
            instruction += ' Say I am sorry for your loss if not already said; ask nothing else.'
    elif vars.get('transfer_requested') == 'yes':
        raise ValueError('Requested transfer has not succeeded; no notes permitted')
    else:
        if vars.get('security_state') != 'verified' or not isinstance(rows, list) or not rows:
            raise ValueError('No verified resolved account')
        recorded_ids = [str(p.get('product_id', '')) for p in recorded if isinstance(p, dict)]
        dispositions = []
        failures = []
        for p in rows:
            pid = str(p.get('product_id', ''))
            if pid in recorded_ids:
                continue
            r = str(p.get('reason', ''))
            if p.get('state') != 'note' or r not in ['refused', 'hardship', 'dispute', 'paid', 'service_error']:
                raise ValueError('Unresolved product')
            item = dict(product_id=pid, reason=r)
            dispositions.append(item)
            if r == 'service_error':
                failures.append(str(p.get('label', 'the affected product')))
            if not any(n.get('product_id') == pid and n.get('reason') == r for n in notes if isinstance(n, dict)):
                needed.append(item)
        if recorded_ids:
            outcome = 'promise'
            instruction = 'Confirm only actually recorded promises. If not yet spoken after the last success, say You will receive a text message confirming this promise.'
        elif dispositions and all(p['reason'] == 'paid' for p in dispositions):
            outcome = 'paid'
            instruction = 'Explain, if not already explained, that payments can take one business day to appear.'
        else:
            outcome = 'no_promise'
            reason = next(p['reason'] for p in dispositions if p['reason'] != 'paid')
            instruction = 'Do not claim an unrecorded promise.'
        for label in failures:
            instruction += ' If not already said, explain that the promise for ' + label + ' could not be recorded.'
    vars['close_outcome'] = outcome
    vars['close_reason'] = reason
    vars['notes_needed'] = needed
    vars['notes_facts'] = json.dumps(needed)
    vars['close_ready'] = 'yes' if not needed else 'no'
    vars['closing_facts'] = instruction + ' Thank the speaker and say goodbye before the final bank call. Final outcome: ' + outcome + (('/' + reason) if reason else '') + '.'
except Exception:
    vars['resolution_ready'] = 'no'
    vars['close_ready'] = 'no'
    vars['notes_needed'] = []
    vars['notes_facts'] = '[]'
    vars['closing_facts'] = 'An unresolved operation prevents a truthful final outcome. Explain that it has not completed; do not claim success, emit notes, close or hang up.'

Final instructions: {{closing_facts}}. Operational hold: {{operational_hold}}. Notes required: {{notes_facts}}. Close permission: {{close_ready}}. Close state: {{close_state}}. Final bank sequence started: {{finalization_started}}. Account retry permitted: {{account_retry_permitted}}. Account state and product labels: {{product_facts}}.
If an operational hold is nonempty, truthfully explain the operation has not completed; do not invent an outcome or hang up. For an account lookup failure with account_retry_permitted=yes, a customer-requested repeat uses the available account-retry action. Otherwise do not invent a retry path. If close itself failed, no further bank call is allowed.
Before the first final note or close, handle a customer interruption first. For a human request ask once whether you can help, and if they insist CALL transfer_to_agent/general. For restructuring CALL transfer_to_agent/restructuring unless hardship takes precedence. For hardship give one short sympathy sentence, offer support, and CALL transfer_to_agent/support if accepted. Do not begin any note while resolving these requests. A payment correction, paid/dispute claim or other changed disposition must be validated before final actions. A transfer abandons unrecorded proposals and prohibits every note.
When the conversation is resolved, give all outstanding actual-success confirmations, the exact text-message sentence after recorded promises, and every required failed-product explanation, callback confirmation, security guidance, sympathy or payment-appearance explanation. Thank the speaker and say goodbye. Then CALL add_note for each listed product without a promise, in account order. Never note on a requested or successful transfer path and never repeat a successful note. After notes start, perform only the remaining final actions; do not reopen negotiation or transfer. On failure follow the result instruction and do not close prematurely.
Once close_ready=yes and required speech is complete, CALL close_call exactly once with the reconciled outcome/reason. Omit reason for promise and paid. It is the last bank call. A successful close leads to silent hangup. Never retry a failed close or hang up without successful close. Do not ask optional questions during this final sequence.
